detectors.description: Pendle implied fixed yields against the floating rate on the same underlying, sized by PT depth

hits.title: PT-SUSDS-26NOV2026 implies 4.89% fixed for 79 days against Sky savings rate at 3.60% — term premium

evidence.why: the same credit pays more fixed than floating for a fixed term, which is a view on the floating rate and nothing else

economics.reason: clears gas, impact and competition at this size

hits.title: PT-REUSD-10DEC2026 implies 10.98% fixed for 93 days against the Sky savings rate (as the risk-free dollar) at 3.60% — credit spread, not a rate trade: nothing here prices that issuer’s credit

evidence.comparison: the Sky savings rate (as the risk-free dollar)
evidence.why: no floating rate on this underlying is readable, so the excess over the risk-free dollar is the market’s price of an issuer’s credit — a judgement this system has not made, quoted here only so it is not mistaken for a term premium

economics.reason: clears gas, impact and competition at this size
